nearest_data: EPA TRI EZ Search overview, opened: https://www.epa.gov/enviro/tri-ez-search. It describes customizable HTML/CSV reports requiring subject, fields, and search criteria. EPA's TRI toolbox supports facility-level downloads and mapping: https://www.epa.gov/toxics-release-inventory-tri-program/tri-toolbox. County aggregate and population-based rate were not obtained in this pass.
